text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, the students took on 
the challenge of a high-difficulty dance 
routine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get started! 
Cue the music!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Woo, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh, wha-whoa...!? 
Which foot am I supposed to step out with 
first?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Except for Daring Heart, 
everyone seems to be struggling quite a 
bit. 
I wonder how Daring Tact is doing—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: (I guess it really is too tricky...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Alright, so in that case... 
Would it be like this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Step-tap-tap♪ Tap-tap-tap♪

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she's doing the exact same moves as 
Daring Heart! 
No way, she got those steps down already?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not bad at all! 
Then how about the next part?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Please give me just a moment...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'm ready.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Tap-tap, tap-tap-tap♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: It's this rhythm, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Great! 
Was that a walk in the park for you?♪
choice_data_list: How can you pull that off...?!
How can you pull that off...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I haven't done anything worth being that 
surprised over.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tracking Daring Heart's steps 
is just like tracking her footprints.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Catching Daring Heart's rhythm 
is just like catching her breath.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Study the tracks, discern the habits. 
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's just like hunting! 
I won't let Daring Heart's movements 
escape me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How thrilling! 
Now that is an extraordinary knack!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, care to take it up a notch? 
I know you can aim even higher!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'd be honored...! 
To share the same perspective on the dance 
floor with Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Please teach me everything, Daring Heart!
choice_data_list:
Someday you might be the one doing the 
teaching.

Someday you might be the one doing the 
teaching.
Aim to surpass her while you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Please teach me everything, Daring Heart!
choice_data_list:
Someday you might be the one doing the 
teaching.

Someday you might be the one doing the 
teaching.
Aim to surpass her while you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You may be right... Hehe. 
With Tact, it's certainly not out of the 
question!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Me as a teacher... Well. 
Funnily enough, I can picture it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me everything you know. 
I promise to master it all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's what I intend to do 
eventually!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, really? 
Then I won't be holding back.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. 
Otherwise, there would be no point in 
competing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let's see if you can surpass me. 
I'm looking forward to it!
